integrity: Complete proof and reproducible diagnostics are included; numerical checks supplement an analytic global proof and do not establish independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Idealized two-flower Poisson-marginal, exact one- or two-productive-visit thresholds, additive fruit values, and continuously divisible expected visit effort. Does not model pollen quality, crop-specific responses, access costs or field calibration. General sigmoidal allocation literature may contain uninspected relevant results; historical priority is provisional.
title: A universal activation jump and later effort reversal for mixed one- and two-visit pollination
